NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) (NO. 5) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of

the National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of National

Heritage) (Heritage Object) (No. 5) Order 2016.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as heritage objects

in the Declaration of Heritage Object (No. 2) 2016 [P.U. (B) 322/2016] as published in

the Gazette on 22 July 2016 and listed in the Register are declared to be

National Heritage.
